test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Precarious
solution: The correct answer is '**Insecure**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Precarious**' is '**Insecure**'. • **Precarious**: not safe or certain; dangerous. (असुरक्षित या अनिश्चित; ख़तरनाक) • *Example: He earned a **precarious** livelihood/living by gambling.* • **Insecure**: not safe or protected. (असुरक्षित) • *Example: This ladder feels a bit **insecure**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Insecure.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Safe**: free from danger; not able to be hurt. (जिसे कोई ख़तरा न हो, जिसे क्षति न पहुँचाई जा सके; सुरक्षित) • **Stable**: steady, firm, and unikely to change. (स्थिर, मज़बूत और जिसमें परिवर्तन संभावित नहीं; अनबदला) • **Strange**: unusual or unexpected. (असामान्‍य या अप्रत्‍याशित; विचित्र; अजीब) 1af:T5cc, The erroneous part is '**for**'.
